name: week
title: The quarry week
subtitle: What went over the bridge, open jobs and what needs chasing

sections.title: Sales in the last 7 days
sections.sql: select site,product,count(*) loads,sum(net_t) tonnes,sum(value) value from v_tickets where day>=current_date-7 group by site,product order by site,tonnes desc

sections.title: Open jobs
sections.sql: select code,customer,name,product,quoted_t,delivered_t,remaining_t,pct,last_load,credit_hold from v_job_progress where status='open' order by pct desc nulls last,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due,kind,record

name: compliance
title: Quarry compliance
subtitle: Consent tonnes, overloads, weighbridge tests, managers and royalties

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: Each check and its source is listed in docs/compliance.md. The limits are house defaults: set yours.
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance order by rule,record

sections.title: Consent tonnes this consent year
sections.sql: select site,consent_ref,year_start,consent_limit_t,dispatched_t,pct from v_consent order by site

sections.title: Royalty returns
sections.sql: select site,payee,period,tonnes,amount,due,lodged_on,ref from v_royalties order by period desc,site

sections.title: Weighbridges
sections.sql: select b.code,s.code site,b.verification_mark,b.last_tested_on,b.last_tested_on+b.test_every_days next_test from weighbridges b join sites s on s.id=b.site_id order by b.code

name: stock
title: Stockpiles
subtitle: Book stock from the last survey, production since and tonnes sold since

sections.title: Book stock
sections.note: Book stock is an estimate between surveys. The surveyor's figure resets it.
sections.sql: select site,product,last_survey,survey_t,produced_t,sold_t,book_t,min_stock_t,low from v_stock_book order by site,product

sections.title: Sales in the last 30 days
sections.sql: select site,product,count(*) loads,sum(net_t) tonnes,round(sum(value)/nullif(sum(net_t),0),2) avg_per_t from v_tickets where day>=current_date-30 group by site,product order by site,tonnes desc
